changes.comment: Remove Python and Go support. Breaking: TracedPythonFunction, TracedPythonFunctionProps, PYTHON_RUNTIME, PYTHON_DEFAULT_ASSET_EXCLUDES, TracedGoFunction, TracedGoFunctionProps and GO_RUNTIME are gone, and the peer dependencies @aws-cdk/aws-lambda-go-alpha and @aws-cdk/aws-lambda-python-alpha are removed. Use TracedNodeFunction.
